newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Polaris cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Polaris cut to hold.

text.p: --Chicago Corp said Thursday it downgraded its rating on Polaris Industries Inc to hold from buy, citing less upside potential in the stock than previously assumed.
--It also reduced its EPS estimates on the company to $2.35 from $2.50 for 1996 and to $2.65 from $2.85 for 1997.

--After the market closed Wednesay, Polaris reported that retail sales of personal watercraft were significantly below plan, Chicago Corp noted in a report. In a conference call, management disclosed that Polaris watercraft retail sales were perhaps 10,000 units lower than shipments this season, it said.
--"With this news, we believe that next year's sales are likely to be negatively affected by this carryover of product in the retail channel," Chicago Corp said.
